title: Answering about an area the docs do not cover
context: A partly ready repo answer called built features unbuilt because their area had no docs. Decide what happens when a needed area is undocumented and code is reachable.

options.label: Check the code automatically, label it as what the code suggests
Offer to check the code in one line
Never check code, only say it is not documented

rationale: Owner chose automatic code check after a wrong confident answer on ddhh-bv/webapp
